title: Why does logrotate fail? Look, then name the error
description: systemd reports logrotate.service failed. The cause is in the journal and in one config file: 'maxsizee' (typo) on line 7 of /etc/logrotate.d/loki. The model has to look (systemctl status / journalctl), not guess, then name the file and the bad option, and must not tell the owner to run commands it could run itself. Tests host tools and diagnosis from raw command output.

judge.rubric: States that logrotate fails because /etc/logrotate.d/loki line 7 has an unknown option 'maxsizee' (typo for maxsize), so logrotate skips the file and exits 1. Suggests the fix. Based on the command output, not guesses.
